payload.text: THE DAY AFTER 3.2.5, LATE EVENING (vc, 2026-10-23, the train after the second bounce). The line is drawn and 3.2.6 is a patch (decision 70); every open issue carries its spec in its record. (1) CLOSED today: 0622, 0626, 0611, 0628, 0627 (37ba1be83 / 46b16553f), 0624 (6a95721f2 / 2b486174f), 0614 (landed 8f1fda69b, closed c59e80779), 0623 (fixed 6bd64b1c8, shots refreshed f2ece5503, closed b5e0fd2b3). LANDED: the preflight gate at f40df8f72; the installed pair is c59e80779 (build all #1 at 18:41Z). The guards pass is done in dc's lane at b129c1b91 (Prodinfra fa4b6a3, Lamplight 7cfa606a5, Conflab ff4d7441, Trellis e07fce8, Anvil 95eff25, Courses 076d6e7). OPEN: 0616, 0617, 0618, 0629, 0630, 0631, 0632, 0633, 0634. (2) THE KOVACS PREFLIGHT, measured: the first run (f40df8f72, hv's terminal) came back red (716 ok, 88 not ok) and paid for itself at once: the order had linked the clone's target dir to the shared one so the binary's real path lay outside the clone and `intent` found no install root (fixed at 6cf058a5a, dc: the binaries copied into the clone, the suite under LANG=C.UTF-8 with every LC_* unset); `comm` under a user locale refused a byte-sorted list in bin/.devbin/cmd/macos (95bf1c6a5, then every comm and the sorts that feed one under LC_ALL=C across bin/.devbin at 511613c96); the in-whiteboard skill had grown past the compact limit at 0627's landing (trimmed at 73060aa1c, ic). The re-run at 95bf1c6a5 is GREEN (804 ok, 0 not ok, three environmental skips), the summary at ~/.local/share/intent/preflight/, and kovacs's target is warm; kovacs then took llvm 23.1.4 and openldap 2.7.2 in Utilz's slot, so the candidate's run meets those. (3) THE COMBINED RUNS in cc's worktree tmp/wt-cc-0616t, one composed tree judged whole (templates-e and -f, fix-s to fix-s5, ic's 0633 wip-b): the first run (20:02Z) measured 0630's stray-file loop (red on fix-s alone, green with fix-s3), flipped 0633's three coverage arms red on the reversed facade with the text-only control green (ic judged it from the logs), caught a REAL REGRESSION in fix-s (the cover round trip: a hand edit to a thread cover no longer carried, a fresh clone losing it silently), and exposed a harness fault (the worktree's target seeded from another worktree's baked that tree's CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR into testkit, so repository-reading arms read the wrong tree; memory written). Ruling 20:18Z: fix-s4 (a view the scan meets with no row takes the scan's entry as Changed, for every load; a renderer's Clean row never overwritten) and fix-s5 (under Ingest a met view whose row is not Clean is re-recorded, with its arm), (D) out of a patch, and THE DROP RULE: a red on 0630's arms sends 0630 whole to 3.2.7 and the run judges templates and 0633 alone. The second run (20:27Z to 20:43Z, testkit guarded) has 0630 GREEN throughout, the fix-s5 control as predicted, and three templates reds the first run could not see (an ST0056 attachment edited without canon, the exit-code CONSUMERS roster behind the hooks' new invocations, tracker citations in hook comments): templates-h as cc proposed, then the whole intentsvcs and intent-cli suites and the shell half on the final tree, GO given 20:43Z. (4) THE HOST: Utilz 2.14.2 cut (19:26Z to 19:44Z) and its Mac runs done; devbin-cc's WP-08 series green (20:01Z to 20:15Z) and devbin-vc's landing suite green (20:29Z to 20:41Z); Molt's suite pair green; Laksa holds cargo, bats and full mix suites until Intent's END; kovacs free until the candidate's run, which vc announces before hv starts it. (5) NEXT, each on vc's word with the sha: the landings in order by literal path (templates with 0616, 0617 and 0618 closed together and `intent claude skills sync`, kovacs-sysadm told the gate needs the 3.2.6 pair; 0630 as one commit of fix-s to fix-s5, closed; ic's 0633 re-banked on the HEAD carrying fix-s, closed); vc's build all #2 on that HEAD ($S/build-all-2.sh: announce, build, promote, intentd restarted, doctor, announce, the verbs' paths committed); dc's known-defects re-drive (refs/bank/dc/kd326/drive.sh) and ic's reference set (regen-reference.sh, both halves against v3.2.5, a second shots run) committed before step 3; cc's CHANGELOG audit of every issue closed since v3.2.5 (0611, 0622 and 0623 carry no line yet); vc runs reference_current_check.sh, the globalfold of intent/wip.md (v3.21, drafted at $S/wip-draft-321.md), the board render chain, then READY to hv. hv's hand then: the candidate's kovacs preflight by the two lines `bin/int prepush --preflight-covers HEAD` prints, then the cut (`intent daemon stop`, `bin/devbin build release v3.2.6` --dry-run first, macos prepare and publish, brew smoke, the app swap, the site), recommended tomorrow morning on the green. (6) 0629 next session (dc); D55 in Devbin; ST0085 for hv's read; the five .py removals and 0634 in hv's hand. No push, no release.
